simple.meaning: חֹשֶׁךְ (chôshek) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the dark ; hence (literally) darkness ; figuratively, misery , destruction , death , ignorance , sorrow , wickedness.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 80 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Joshua, 1 Samuel, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 1:2. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹשֶׁךְ (H2822).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חֹשֶׁךְ (chôshek) / H2822 is traced through Genesis 1:2, Genesis 1:4, Genesis 1:5, Genesis 1:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.
